edge_control.text: {{subject}} 的辨识边缘短而清楚，外围轮廓较弱并断续融入相邻色面。

texture.text: 大暗色面轻微呈现细纸粒，并保持主视觉细节清楚。

color_palette.text: Let low-saturation cool blue-gray dominate the environment; concentrate a small amber accent in the main readable area of {{subject}}.

edge_control.text: Use short, clear recognition edges on {{subject}}; keep peripheral contours weaker, broken, and merged into neighboring color masses.

detail_density.text: Concentrate detail on the most recognizable part of {{subject}}; leave most of the environment as simple color masses and sparse contours.

texture.text: Let fine paper grain show subtly on broad dark areas, with focal details kept clear.

visual_path.text: In {{environment}}, use low-contrast space cues to lead the eye to one main focus where warm color, clear edges, and the highest detail converge.

natural_language_zh:
以 {{subject}} 为主体。

场景为 {{environment}}。

低饱和冷灰蓝环境占大面积，少量琥珀暖色集中在 {{subject}} 的主读区域。{{subject}} 的辨识边缘短而清楚，外围轮廓较弱并断续融入相邻色面。细节集中于 {{subject}} 的主要辨认处，环境大部分区域表现为简单色块和疏略轮廓。优先采用。大暗色面轻微呈现细纸粒，并保持主视觉细节清楚。

在 {{environment}} 中用低对比线索将视线引到唯一主读点，让暖色、清晰边缘和主要细节在那里会合。
